item.title: Eganville man wins $1 million LOTTO 6/49 Gold Ball prize
item.description: An Eganville resident is $1 million richer after winning a LOTTO 6/49 Gold Ball prize in the December 13 draw. Steven Zomers, a self-employed father of three, claimed the prize after checking his ticket using the Ontario Lottery and Gaming Corporation’s mobile app. Zomers said he had been playing the lottery on and off for […]

item.title: OPP look into bank investigator scam after Petawawa victim loses $4K
item.description: Ontario Provincial Police are investigating after a Petawawa-area resident lost more than $4,000 in what police describe as a bank investigator scam. The Upper Ottawa Valley Detachment of the OPP says the victim was contacted by fraudsters impersonating bank staff, online merchants or law enforcement officials, who claimed the victim’s account had been compromised and […]

item.title: Four left homeless after Laurentian Valley house fire
item.description: LAURENTIAN VALLEY TWP. — Four people and two dogs are homeless, but safe after a house fire on Greenwood Road in Laurentian Valley Township on the afternoon of Feb. 5.
